body:
## [3.113.0] - 2026-11-23

### Features

- update expiration logic to handle DST and improve test coverage
- implement loyalty program expiration logic and tests
- Update bundle promotion display logic to show discounts per product row
- enhance customer DTO to include first and last name fields
- Introduce bundle promotion display logic and logging context
- accept 12-digit manual codes (AION-858)
- add atomic single-use lifecycle checkout for AION-375

### Bug Fixes

- retain recovered coverage and generation-aware checkpoints
- recover only affected datasets across revision gaps
- bind deferred credit issuance to the sync account
- recover pending checkouts and use confirmed active-policy results
- use typed exact source order lookup
- allow absent fuel metadata for returns
- recover incomplete selected receipts from Odoo
- prevent repeated and stale variant confirmations
- keep search completion on its owning dialog
- merge optional loyalty metadata atomically
- preserve captured work and output gates after durable save
- release saved carts before receipt metadata
- honor requested statuses when repairing upload work
- reconcile revision gaps without skipping late datasets
- send suspended-order timestamps in UTC (AION-871)
- allocate bundle display savings from remaining values
- honor local default invoice setting for sales and refunds
- acknowledge verified zero-value recovery without an invoice
- restore SDK upgrade validation
- safely replace leased retry headers
- sync generated credit note numbers to Odoo
- drain healthy pre-close batches and continue legacy repair
- bound outage retries and continue healthy backlogs (AION-871)
- upgrade Drift and preserve pooled transaction notifications
- keep slow session recovery on startup screen
- adjust product display logic for branch pricing policy
- wait for resolved POS default before displaying prices
- enhance product display logic for customer pricelists
- preserve explicit pricelists in full customer refresh
- preserve saved bundle promotion priority
- include prior savings in bundle receipt subtotals
- recover late startup session reads
- reuse scoped v4 and v5 customer snapshots
- restore saved customer name components when editing
- archive confirmed tests through durable backend acknowledgements
- preserve customer first and last names in Odoo requests
- apply order discounts after bundles (AIONE-876)
- release only the confirmed order retry delay
- isolate retry command categories
- separate operational retry scheduling
- pin internal-only lifecycle bridge enforcement
- pin spendable retain-balance refund funding
- bound refresh recovery and pricing restarts
- pin authorized native retain-balance completion
- preserve paired legacy authorization behavior
- pin native completed-order redemption
- pin first-funding policy enforcement
- pin payment-bound single-use redemption
- validate manifest build numbers before use
- retry transient order upload failures with bounded backoff

### Other Changes

- exercise scoped catch-up against local Odoo HTTP
- align reset workspace fake with checkout callback
- zero-total session clearing now occurs after neutralization, preserving the basket and recovery cache on failure
- isolate logger in focus regression fixture
- fixed a recovery bug: .distinct() discarded the restored pricing setting after a temporary configuration error, leaving prices blocked.
- repair release documentation handoff to test laptop
- limit recovery to Desktop and trim scope
- accept normalized PayTag cache restoration
- Fixed zero-total PayTag checkout to: - Complete the existing draft instead of creating a second order. - Clear the completed basket and recovery cache before returning to regular POS.
- capture history blocking and refund reservations
- Updated [Self Paytag cancellation (line 374)](/C:/docker/AIONE_PROJECTS/flutter_pos/lib/features/paytag_self_order/presentation/paytag_payment_screen/paytag_payment_flow.dart:374). - Sends escape-payment once and waits for its result. - Shows an error if cancellation fails. - Prevents late status responses from finalizing a cancelled payment. - Handles cancellation before the payment index arrives.
- capture receipt return selection failures
- . When stored name components are unknown, editing only one field now blocks submission and asks the cashier to re-enter both names or retry loading details.
- Confirmed and fixed. Each name field now tracks edits independently: - Failed/pending lookup: the untouched inferred component is omitted from Save. - Delayed success: the untouched field receives its stored value without overwriting the cashier’s edit.
- Enhance customer name handling: add initial first and last name support, preserve edits during late lookups, and improve test coverage for name fields
- Enhance customer form handling: add name parts loading state and improve validation logic
- Fixed. Failed detail lookups now leave name fields blank and disabled, with a clear retry warning. Unrelated saves preserve the original name.
- exercise finalization retry through active checkout read
- align invoice policy regression fixtures with Nexo settings
- refresh fuel goldens for Flutter 3.47.8
- pired promotions now appear last, with non-expired promotions first. Priority order is preserved within each group.
- distinguish focused diagnostics from PR validation
- capture and isolate fuel visual comparisons
- Updated X to share Z’s print layout, including all requested sections, formatting, alignment, and transaction counts.
- isolate history presentation dependencies
- update controller doubles for manual sign-in
- Fixed the refund crash. Verified posted prices now bypass duplicate discount allocation, including during promotion-label generation.
- resolve final review analyzer findings
- align promotion review build versions
- Fixed: failed detail lookups now omit untouched guessed name components. Explicit edits are tracked separately, while new customers still send both names.
- All three override signatures are updated. The sync tests hit an environment issue: SQLite is installed as libsqlite3.so.0, but the tests look for libsqlite3.so. I’ve added a temporary alias under /tmp and restarted the checks.
- Limit checkout fix to zero totals under cash rounding
- enable SQLite read workers on Android and Linux
- Fixed. The table now shows cached names immediately while details load, then replaces them with the saved first and last names when available. Slow or offline requests no longer hide customer names.
- allow concurrent SQLite reads on Windows
- Revert "fix(AIONE-892): restore saved customer name components when editing"
- Fix rounded-zero checkout and stale archived carts
- pin retain invoice compatibility correction
- pin legacy upgrade compatibility correction
- pin historical credit migration fix
- pair expiry and reversal review fixes
- pin legacy compatibility safeguards
- pair POS with reviewed lifecycle API fixes
- assert deferred wallet redemption in architecture guard
- Refresh now downloads the complete customer list in the background and replaces the cache after successful completion. The selector updates automatically.
